name: ppt-style-studio
description: 精緻圖解元件庫 · PPT Style Studio

scripts.test: python3 tools/stylekit_assets_test.py && npm run test:page-footer && npm run test:table && npm run test:icons && node tools/test.js
scripts.test:table: node tools/table_model_integrity_test.js && node tools/table_range_model_test.js && node tools/table_range_family_test.js && npm run test:table-palette && npm run test:table-emphasis && node tools/table_data_grid_test.js && npm run test:table-reset && node tools/table_workbench_test.js --model-only && node tools/table_workbench_test.js --dom-only && npm run test:table-appearance
scripts.test:icons: node tools/icon_components_test.js && node tools/icon_variants_test.js && node tools/icon_pack_test.js && node tools/hexagon_export_test.js
scripts.test:range: node tools/table_range_model_test.js && node tools/table_range_family_test.js && npm run test:table-palette
scripts.test:table-appearance: node tools/table_appearance_test.js && node tools/table_appearance_ui_test.js && STUDIO_HTML=PPT-Style-Studio.html node tools/table_appearance_ui_test.js
scripts.test:table-palette: node tools/table_highlight_palette_test.js && node tools/table_range_ui_test.js && STUDIO_HTML=PPT-Style-Studio.html node tools/table_range_ui_test.js
